item.title: A Reading in English and Spanish with Mónica de la Fuente — Thu Nov 12, 7:00 PM — Many Rivers Books & Tea
item.description: A Reading in English and Spanish with Mónica de la Fuente​ ​ Do you remember what it felt like when someone read to you as a child? ​ ¿Requerdas como te sentias cuando eras niño y alguien te leia? Many Rivers Books & Tea invites English- and Spanish-speaking families to join local author Mónica de la Fuente for an interactive reading of her mindfulness picture book, Something in My View. More than a traditional story time, this event will be a shared experience for children and the grown-ups who love reading to them. ​ At first glance, the book is a simple story about bubbles. As the story unfolds, children and adults are invited to discover something unexpected through curiosity, conversation, and reflection. Following the reading, children will enjoy a bubble-inspired art activity. ​ Something in My View was inspired by Mónica’s many years of meditation practice and a desire to offer children – and the adults who read with them – a simple way to pause, share a quiet moment togethe

item.title: The (Unbelievably True) Story of Nicky O — Thu Nov 12, 7:00 PM — Rancho Cotate High School
item.description:
*The (Unbelievably True) Story of Nicky O,* a new rock musical based on an incredible true story. Nicky O’Neill was an aspiring teenage rockstar when, in 2003, he became the youngest victim in the deadly Station Nightclub fire. Following his death, a series of surprising supernatural events unfolded, uniting his family & friends in the belief that Nicky is forever watching over them from above.
With original music by Nicky O’Neill and friends, alongside a brand new book by local thespian (and Nicky’s sister-in-law) Maureen O’Neill, *Nicky O* is a moving, heartfelt, and surprisingly funny message that our loved ones are never gone…they walk among us.
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: Paint & Sip with Genevieve Elkin — Fri Nov 13, 5:30 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Join us for a relaxed and social paint & sip evening. You'll be guided step-by-step through painting a scenic view using acrylics, with plenty of room to make it your own.
Whether you follow along or add your own creative twist, the focus is on enjoying the process and having fun. Sip on a beverage, come with friends or meet new ones, and settle into a laid-back night of painting and connection. No experience needed - just show up and create.
Genevieve Elkin was Born and raised in Mill Valley, California and is a multidisciplinary artist now based in Petaluma. She earned a BFA in Illustration from Parsons School of Design and has professionally managed art departments, supporting artists and new media on high-profile projects. Genevieve loves painting, drawing, and exploring ceramics, and enjoys helping students experiment, have fun, and develop their own creative voice.
To learn more:@gennaelkin
Sponsored by

item.title: DJ Cal — Fri Nov 13, 10:00 PM — Perch + Plow
item.description:
Raised in the Bay Area, DJ Cal has gained a reputation for doing multi-genre set lists designed to move the crowds with a blend of Trap, EDM,Hip-Hop and Reggaeton music. He calls the city of Santa Rosa his home, but you might’ve heard his mixes on-air across the nation \(San Francisco, Las Vegas, Orlando, Palms Springs, etc.\). He currently holds a spot as a Mixshow DJ on Fresno California B95, with Teezzy Radio, Last Call and Friday night street party. DJ CAL has several Bay Area and Northern California venues under his belt and you can catch him performing and hanging out with the hottest names in music around the Bay. He also has created his own day party, "Brunch Behavior" that has gained much popularity in the North Bay. Also, his work has been supported and featured by various blogs, websites and record pools; DJ City, MyMP3Pool, BpmSupreme and SmashTheClub, and more. DJ CAL has worked hard to make his own mark in the music industry.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Write & Collage: Words, Images & Memory — Sat Nov 14, 10:00 AM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Join Marlene Cullen for a creative two-hour experience that brings writing and collage together. In the first hour, guided freewriting prompts invite you to explore memorable moments, stories, and experiences in a welcoming, supportive environment. In the second hour, transform those reflections into a visual expression using images, colors, and textures.
No writing or art experience is necessary—just bring your curiosity and a willingness to explore.
Bring: A notebook and pen. Collage materials will be provided, and you're welcome to bring a favorite poem, magazines, photographs, or other materials you'd like to incorporate.
Marlene Cullen is the founder of Writers Forum and creator of Jumpstart Writing Workshops. Through her website and blog, The Write Spot, she shares resources and inspiration to help writers discover and develop their voices.
The Write Spot anthologies edited by Marlene are collections of short stories, poems, and vignettes with prompts to encourage writing.
S

item.title: Healing Hearts - A Healing Sip & Paint Experience — Sun Nov 15, 1:00 PM — Vino Godfather
item.description:
Healing Hearts by JassverArt is more than a paint class - it's a creative experience designed to help you relax, reconnect, and create from the heart. Begin with a gentle guided meditation, then paint your own beautiful wooden heart with step-by-step instruction. No experience is necessary - just bring an open heart. Gather with friends, enjoy the beautiful atmosphere at Vino Godfather Winery, and leave with a one-of-a-kind piece of art and a peaceful heart.
Your first glass of wine, of your choice, is included with admission. All art supplies will be provided. Bring your own protective covering if you'd like. Charcuterie items and other snacks will be available for purchase, along with additional wine by the glass or bottle. There will be a short break to replenish drinks and grab snacks.
Space is limited to 20 guests. Class will take place in backyard venue, dress accordingly, evenings can be cool.

item.title: Beginner Friendly Sewing Workshop — Tue Nov 17, 5:30 PM — Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
item.description: The Vallejo John F. Kennedy is hosting a start-to-finish guided sewing program making an electric heating pad cover. To make our covers we will be using an old flannel sheet. We will provide one fabric option, but you are more than welcome to bring your own materials if you have any you would prefer to use. If you bring your own fabric, please make sure it is a stable woven. We recommend flannels \(like an old flannel shirt, pajama bottoms, or a pillow case\) for cozier experience when using the heating pads, but quilting cottons and linens would work as well. We have 5 sewing machines available for the workshop. If you have your own machine you would like to bring, please let us so know so we can set up the room accordingly. If you have any questions, please call the library: \(866\) 572-7587. Due to limited machinery and supplies, we require registration for this event. item.title: Follow the Clucking Money: Petaluma's Forever Bills — Wed Nov 18, 7:00 PM — Petaluma Community Center
item.description:
**When the chickens come home to roost, who's paying for the coop?**
At our first two workshops in the Follow the Clucking Money series, we cracked open the expenditure and revenue sides of Petaluma's budget — all those tricky questions about where the money comes from and the tough trade-offs we make in deciding where it goes.
In this workshop, we’re scratching beneath the surface of Petaluma’s long-term commitments, including our roads that could use a little love. These promises keep incubating year after year, and some of them are hatching!
What does Petaluma owe its future? And how do we pay the clucking bill?
At the workshop, you'll get:
A quick recap of workshops #1 and #2, in case you missed them
A first look at what we’ve learned about Petaluma’s long term commitments
A friendly, no‑jargon walkthrough of a case study
A chance to tell us what you want to explore next
A sneak peek at upgrades to our tools at followthecluckingmoney.org
Your voice matters. Your curiosity
